# מטוסי נייר | Paper Planes

> Hebrew-language travel podcast ("מטוסי נייר" / Paper Planes) with 178+ episodes covering destinations worldwide, plus practical travel tools: eSIM, travel insurance, discount codes, dummy return tickets, and country guides. Site is in Hebrew; some episode content also has English transcripts.

## Site
- Home: https://paperplanes.co.il/
- About: https://paperplanes.co.il/about.html
- All episodes (listing): https://paperplanes.co.il/
- Travel guides: https://paperplanes.co.il/guides.html
- Discount codes: https://paperplanes.co.il/discounts.html
- eSIM: https://paperplanes.co.il/esim.html
- Travel insurance: https://paperplanes.co.il/insurance.html
- Dummy return ticket: https://paperplanes.co.il/dummy-ticket.html
- Contact: https://paperplanes.co.il/contact.html
- Sitemap (machine-readable, all URLs): https://paperplanes.co.il/sitemap.xml
